mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 99 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 51.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is updating their trishaw program, requiring a signed waiver for all participants to ensure safety and clear legal boundaries. Also, the City Clerk is seeking student artists for an I Voted sticker contest, with submissions open until August 7 for the November election.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Louie. Looking ahead, don't miss the downtown farmer's market or live music at Paddy Mac's on Wednesday.
In our weekly police update, officers reported a hit-and-run incident that occurred on July 26 near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane involving an 83-year-old driver.
Don't miss out on today's flavor of the day, Snickers Swirl. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
